description:
Creates a new anonymous (guest) player account that needs only a display name and returns its anonymousToken.
Use when: a player starts without email, for example on first launch of a game with guest play.
Not for: players who sign up with email and password (use horizon_signup_email) or returning guests (use horizon_signin_anonymous with the stored anonymousToken).
Side effects: creates one new player account per call after the player chooses guest play. Omitted/false includeRefreshToken starts no session; true also issues access and refresh tokens. Never automatically repeat an uncertain signup.
Returns: {userId, username, isAnonymous: true, anonymousToken, authStatus, createdAt}, plus session tokens only when opted in. The server alone issues the 32-character anonymousToken. Store it in platform secure storage. Without accessToken, call horizon_signin_anonymous.
Errors: 400 for an invalid displayName: fix the name and retry. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

displayName.description: Display name shown on leaderboards (max 30 characters)

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

name: horizon_signup_anonymous
title: Sign Up Anonymously
